title: 第663章 鲛人秘汤第662章 移植成效
slug: 巫师开局获得传承之一
lines: “咔嚓……咯吱、咯吱……”
没多久，实验台再度被血液浸透，只是这一次，台上那维持实验体生命的阵法并未开启……
很快，台上那原本还有些壮硕的鲛人之躯，便成了一具血淋淋的残破躯体。
它的身上血肉模糊，脖颈、肚子等部位皆出现了不大不小的血洞，而里面的器官也被修斯相继取走。
而待他把最后的一对鱼鳃放入容器里，鲛人秘汤的所需鲛人材料便都已收集完毕。
因为对方是经过血脉移植后形成的鲛人，所以还尚未触碰海之律法，因此会被算作新生儿。
同理，如果是用其身上部位所炼制而成的鲛人秘汤，喝下后的效果也会是变成“新生儿”
鲛人。
此刻，望着面前排列得整整齐齐的容器，修斯满意的点了点头。
“嗯，那么接下来就是鲛人秘汤的炼制了。”
出乎修斯意料的是，芙格丽尖塔下一次实验的开启，竟然要等很久的时间。
但也正好，这段时间，让他得以潜心钻研配方，好炼制出鲛人秘汤。
两周后……
阴暗的地下室里，修斯站在特制的大坩埚前，目光死死盯着锅里，眉头不时紧皱。
在他的身侧，则整整齐齐码着数瓶已经空了的魔药瓶。
这些瓶里原本装着的，便是组成出鲛人秘汤的数种魔药。
而里面的药液，如今已尽数被他倒入了坩埚里。
“咕咚、咕咚……”
此刻的坩埚里，颜色各异的药液正在互相交融，发生的剧烈反应令液面不住的咕咚冒泡。
而修斯就站在一旁不断调控，好让它们可以彻底融合。
有了组合塑皮药剂的经验，他的动作已经熟稔了许多，药水不断搅动，其中一些的颜色已经越来越淡。
与此同时，坩锅里的蓝色药水翻腾得越来越剧烈，一缕源自深海的气息逐渐从锅里弥漫开来。
“咕噜咕噜……”
很快，只听“噗呲”
一声，一缕绿色的气体从液面散出，而锅里的绿色药水也逐渐消融，融进了最中心的蓝色药剂里。
显然，其中一剂魔药已经融入。
一个小时过去，锅里再度传来了几声“噗呲”
的轻响。
而伴随着五颜六色的气体逸散而出，锅里药水的颜色也越来越少。
到最后，锅里便只剩下了蓝色与白色两种颜色的魔药在互相纠缠。
不过，其中蓝色药水已然占据了大半的面积，几乎要将白色的掩盖，可见再过不久就要将其吞噬。
趁着这段时间，修斯顿了顿，随即慢慢垂下了右手，从储物袋里取出了那根蓝色的条状物。
紧接着，他便缓缓抬起了手，将其伸到了坩埚上方。
只是，就在即将放开的刹那，他的指尖却下意识地顿住。
“咕咚咕咚……”
修斯垂下眼，睫毛在眼下投出一小片阴影。
他的喉结轻轻动了动，就连那双素来平静的眸子里，也浮现出了几分迟疑。
“咕咚咕咚……”
content_en:
"Chila——"
"Crack... creak, creak..."
Not long after, the experimental platform was soaked with blood again, but this time, the formation on the platform that maintained the life of the experimental subjects was not activated...
Soon, the originally sturdy shark body on the stage turned into a bloody and broken body.
Its body was covered in blood and flesh, and there were large and small blood holes in its neck, belly and other parts, and the organs inside were also taken away by Hughes one after another.
"Gudong..."
By the time he put the last pair of fish gills into the container, all the necessary ingredients for the shark's secret soup had been collected.
Because the opponent is a mermaid formed after blood transplantation, he has not yet touched the law of the sea, so he will be counted as a newborn.
In the same way, if the shark's secret soup is made from its body parts, the effect of drinking it will also be to turn into a "newborn baby"
Shark.
At this moment, looking at the neatly arranged containers in front of him, Hughes nodded with satisfaction.
"Well, then the next step is to refine the shark's secret soup."
"..."
To Hughes's surprise, it would take a long time for the next experiment at Fugli Spire to start.
But it just so happened that during this period of time, he was able to concentrate on studying the formula to refine the secret soup of the shark.
Two weeks later…
In the dark basement, Hughes stood in front of a special large crucible, his eyes fixed on the pot, and his brows furrowed from time to time.
Beside him, there were several empty potion bottles neatly stacked.
These bottles originally contained several kinds of magic potions that made up the secret soup of the sharks.
And all the liquid inside has now been poured into the crucible by him.
"Gudong, Gudong..."
In the crucible at this moment, medicinal liquids of different colors were mingling with each other, and the violent reaction caused the liquid surface to bubble continuously.
And Hughes stood aside and continued to control them so that they could be completely integrated.
With the experience of combining skin plastic potions, he has become very familiar with the movements. The potions are constantly stirring, and the color of some of them has become lighter and lighter.
At the same time, the blue potion in the crucible was churning more and more violently, and a breath of air originating from the deep sea gradually spread from the pot.
"Gulu gulu..."
"Puff——"
Soon, I just heard "puff"
With a sound, a wisp of green gas emitted from the liquid surface, and the green potion in the pot gradually melted into the blue potion in the center.
Apparently, one of the potions had been incorporated.
"..."
An hour later, a few more "puffs" came from the pot.
The soft sound.
As the colorful gases escape, the color of the potion in the pot becomes less and less.
In the end, there were only two colors of blue and white potions left in the pot, entangled with each other.
However, the blue potion has already occupied most of the area, almost covering up the white one, which shows that it will be swallowed up soon.
Taking advantage of this time, Houston paused, then slowly lowered his right hand and took out the blue strip from the storage bag.
Then, he slowly raised his hand and stretched it over the crucible.
However, just when he was about to let go, his fingertips subconsciously paused.
"Gudong Gudong..."
Hughes lowered his eyes, his eyelashes casting a small shadow under his eyes.
His Adam's apple moved slightly, and even his usually calm eyes showed a bit of hesitation.
"Gudong Gudong..."
